items.title: 🚀 Release `autogpt-platform-beta-v0.9.0`
items.summary: 🔥 What's New? New Features #15824 - Add measures and admin tools against multi-account abuse (by @Pwuts ) #14553 - Self-host from the Docker Hub image, with a Windows installer (by @ntindle ) #14981 - Every block declares its effect; Auto judges cheap outward actions and asks first on costly ones (by @Pwuts ) #15675 - Add admin users page to look up, ban and impersonate a user, with rate limits folded in (by @Pwuts ) #15859 - Send the browser tools' traffic through an egress proxy (by @ntindle ) #15215 - Redesign usage limits and review upgrade charges (by @Torantulino ) #15388 - AutoPilot turns pause at their limits instead of dying, and Keep going picks them up (by @ntindle ) #15390 - Resume or send a chat's turn when the budget resets (by @ntindle ) #15403 - Add send at reset, the out-of-budget panel for Max, and a running-low hint (by @ntindle ) #15585 - Add voice mode to the + menu; model and token usage open as dialogs (by @0ubbe ) #15115 - Add per-expert default approval mode for new web chats (by @Abhi1992002 ) #14551 - Distill private account and Expert skills during dreaming (by @ntindle ) #14960 - Add durable per-scope schedule registry for dream and community jobs with lifecycle hooks and backfill (by @ntindle ) #14961 - Add durable DreamPass record written from the sync and batch dream paths (by @ntindle ) #14970 - Add one guard against overlapping dream passes and a stop path built on the DreamPass record (by @ntindle ) #15374 - A scheduled chat says once why its run was skipped (by @ntindle ) #15375 - Pause a scheduled chat that keeps failing the same way, and say why (by @ntindle ) #15377 - Alert the owner when a scheduled chat pauses, list it on Home, resume it on reconnect (by @ntindle ) #15400 - Run a scheduled chat less often from its usage-limit note (by @ntindle ) #14865 - Serve the swap proxy from a service that exposes only its two calls (by @kcze ) #14868 - Hand boxes behind the swap proxy placeholders, not tokens (by @kcze ) #15874 - Add multi-choice, answer review, full keyboard use and touch sizing for expert onboarding cards (by @0ubbe ) #15836 - Hire the whole recommended team in one click on the hire step (by @Pwuts ) #12652 - Show a changelog notification for new releases (by @ntindle ) #15850 - Send Postmark email deliveries, opens, clicks and bounces to PostHog (by @kcze ) #15307 - Add Claude Haiku 5.5 to the LLM catalog (by @ntindle ) #15566 - items.summary_html:
🔥 What's New? New Features
  • #15824 - Add measures and admin tools against multi-account abuse (by @Pwuts)
  • #14553 - Self-host from the Docker Hub image, with a Windows installer (by @ntindle)
  • #14981 - Every block declares its effect; Auto judges cheap outward actions and asks first on costly ones (by @Pwuts)
  • #15675 - Add admin users page to look up, ban and impersonate a user, with rate limits folded in (by @Pwuts)
  • #15859 - Send the browser tools' traffic through an egress proxy (by @ntindle)
  • #15215 - Redesign usage limits and review upgrade charges (by @Torantulino)
  • #15388 - AutoPilot turns pause at their limits instead of dying, and Keep going picks them up (by @ntindle)
  • #15390 - Resume or send a chat's turn when the budget resets (by @ntindle)
  • #15403 - Add send at reset, the out-of-budget panel for Max, and a running-low hint (by @ntindle)

items.title: Preview seed fixture (rolling)
items.summary: Rolling, fully SYNTHETIC preview-database seed fixture baked from dev@b4f71cfacd92 (migration head: 20261022000000_add_brain_dump_error_reason). Preview environments restore fixture.dump.gz (custom-format, gzipped, platform schema only, including _prisma_migrations) BEFORE running a PR's own migrations, so schema changes run against populated tables. RESTORE: apply restore-preamble.sql to the target database first (it creates the platform schema and installs the vector + pg_trgm extensions into it, which pg_dump --schema=platform omits), then run 'gunzip -c fixture.dump.gz | pg_restore -d --no-owner' WITHOUT --exit-on-error (the dump's own CREATE SCHEMA collides benignly with the preamble's). SECURITY INVARIANT: this bake holds no cloud credentials and has no read path to any real database — it runs entirely against a throwaway Postgres container and contains only Faker-generated synthetic rows plus the already-public marketplace agent exports checked into autogpt_platform/backend/agents/. This asset is regenerated on every eligible dev push and weekly; treat it as disposable.
